OK, so `fr_sbuff_extend` for the input sbuff (which has no `extend` function) returns `remaining` if `remaining >= 1`, or 0 if `remaining == 0`. So the loop in `fr_sbuff_out_bstrncpy` copies exactly `len` bytes from the input. Safe.
